title: Render Hoodi execution-client workload
expected_outcome: A separate hardened Nethermind Hoodi StatefulSet has a verified immutable image, encrypted 2 TiB gp3 storage, probes, anti-affinity from Prysm, and constrained network paths without deployment.
constraints: No deployment, cluster/AWS access, validator keys, mainnet, image publishing, secrets, snapshots, or merge.
Select and record a Hoodi-compatible Nethermind stable release and OCI digest before workload implementation.

delegations.escalation_trigger: manifest violates an established workload-hardening convention
a required invariant cannot be represented against the rendered manifests
